status: Validated for publication; deployment and browser evidence are recorded in the accompanying task after the commit.

content.reviewScope: Three author packages with lesson-level source mapping, complete peer reading of questions/options/keys/explanations and documented additional primary-source checks. This is not a certification of all existing app content.
content.media: No new media imported; existing licensed category photographs remain contextual covers.

navigation: A lesson links directly to its actually available cards; course and lesson scope remain exact through printing and the return link.
Small lesson decks are complete on first server render; global decks retain a small initial seed and a separately guarded full-bank request.
SSR uses the existing paid-account guard and private/no-store headers; only the two exact guarded page routes bypass a redundant middleware lookup.
Malformed or unknown selections never fall back to a different course or the full bank. Old fetches and old errors cannot replace a new selection.

technicalValidation.qualification: Technical tests verify structure, integration, state, access and transport. They do not prove scientific correctness. Byte reduction concerns this metadata payload, not total app loading speed.

nextWork: Continue the active content goal with genuinely different, source-checked learning objectives in the existing categories.
Introduce paged flashcard delivery before a growing full-bank response approaches the hosting response-size limit; retain all course/lesson scope and integrity checks.
Keep counts reproducible. Central course questions and their derived cards are not additional independent facts, and lower-bound competitor claims are not exact inventories.
